Package com.project.cooking.kitchen

Class Ingredient

java.lang.Object
com.project.cooking.kitchen.Ingredient
public class Ingredient extends Object
Represents an ingredient used in cooking operations. Includes stock levels, expiry date, thresholds, and availability.
Author:
abood
